newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output seen at 9.5 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output seen at 9.5 mln bales.

text.p: The state-run Pakistan Central Cotton Committee (PCCC) said on Tuesday cotton output from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop would be in the range of 9.5 million bales (375 lbs each), down from a target of 10 million bales and 1995/96 production of 9.96 million.
The PCCC said in a statement the production estimate made by its standing committee for assessing the cotton crop was tentative and should not be taken as a final estimate.
"The next three to four weeks are crucial, which could affect the yield per acre either way," it said.
The statement blamed pest and leaf curl virus attacks and rain and temperature variations for the fall in output. Crops on some 40,000 hectares had been damaged by floods and rain.
The committee said the estimated area under cotton was 3.134 million hectares up from 2.992 million last year.
Arrivals up to October 10 in ginneries were at 1.241 million bales, against 783,000 bales at the same time last year, it said.
